title: 安妮·提伯斯野餐
description: 红发小女孩安妮穿保暖紫色连衣裙，和毛绒提伯斯坐在格子垫上分享小饼干。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Annie remains a little girl with a short red bob, a dark headband with small pointed ear-like decorations, large curious eyes, and her beloved brown teddy bear Tibbers. Give her a modest long-sleeved purple dress, opaque warm tights, little sturdy boots, and a tiny backpack. Tibbers is a friendly ordinary plush bear with stitched features, never a threatening fiery monster.
art_direction.scene: She sits on a small checked picnic blanket and offers a round biscuit to Tibbers, who is propped upright beside her. A closed lunchbox and one apple sit nearby. Two softly drawn trees and a low patch of flowers suggest a safe sunny garden. Emphasize her childlike delight and the bear's soft stitched paws, with no flames.
art_direction.palette: berry purple, ginger red, teddy brown, picnic yellow
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
